raw_text:
{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Includes contrib/guix/manifest_codesign.scm, contrib/guix/libexec/codesign.sh, and CI container configuration backports for the release branch.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Updates release codesigning scripts and CI configuration for the v32.0 release branch. Guix manifest and codesign fixes ensure release binary build and signing integrity for the upcoming release candidate."
    },
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Documentation changes in doc/man/ and doc/release-notes-empty-template.md follow mechanically from backports and release tooling.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The documentation updates consist of regenerated man pages and release note templates accompanying the backported code rather than primary documentation work."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/policy/fees/estimator_man.cpp and src/policy/fees/mempool_estimator.cpp to backport fee estimation fallback logic.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes fee estimation to fall back to block policy instead of failing outright when the mempool estimator lacks data. As commit 635745539f notes, 'When the mempool policy estimator cannot produce an estimate, GetFeeRateEstimate() now returns the block policy estimate rather than an error.'"
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to src/node/miner.cpp merely assign log lines to the new dedicated BCLog::MINING log category.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR does not modify block template construction or mining RPC interfaces, only adding a mining log category."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/net_processing.cpp and src/netgroup.cpp to alter peer discouragement logic for private broadcast connections.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents misbehaving private broadcast connections from triggering node-wide address bans. As commit 8ec0fd46f4 explains, it keeps 'private broadcast connections outside normal discouragement handling' while still disconnecting misbehaving peers."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "RPC changes are incidental to fee estimator fallback and OpenRPC metadata hints without changes to the RPC interface or transport.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Changes in src/rpc/ merely expose underlying fee estimator adjustments or correct schema argument default hints."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test changes under test/functional/ update area tests for backported fixes rather than modifying the test framework.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The functional test modifications test the specific fee estimation, Tor control, and ASMap backports rather than altering test harnesses or runner infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/bitcoin-tx.cpp, src/bitcoin-util.cpp, and src/bitcoin-wallet.cpp to enable hardware SHA256 detection.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "speedup",
      "rationale": "Enables hardware SHA256 acceleration in standalone CLI utilities, addressing a performance regression where tools defaulted to generic SHA256. Commit 02a7f11038 reports that 'On an M2 Max, grind is ~5x faster and signing 2000 P2PKH inputs with bitcoin-tx ~2.3x.'"
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/init.cpp to adjust shutdown sequencing of validation callbacks and fee estimator persistence.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Resolves a shutdown race condition where pending fee estimate updates could be dropped. Commit 651670dec1 notes that shutdown previously saved and unregistered the fee estimator before draining queued validation callbacks, causing recent block updates to be lost."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to src/wallet/walletutil.cpp and src/script/descriptor.cpp are internal string optimization helpers without the wallet label.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The descriptor string serialization refactoring is an internal optimization rather than a substantive change to wallet behavior or fund management."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 1,
    "performance": 1,
    "user_value": 1,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
